join.outcome_unknown: An unknown outcome never implies rollback.
join.key_resolution: A verified resolver correlates the workspace/run and workspace/original-operation keys to stable numeric keys. The proposed Entity enforces unique operation_key along with identity id. The journal must atomically bind the exact tuple and collision/refusal behavior.

admission.precondition: Complete bundle and authorized effects staged and verified. All authoritative readers qualified.
admission.local: Inert draft custody only on this cross-boundary route.
admission.receipt: Bind acyclic decision cores and deterministic consequences before CAS. Seal the application receipt against the observed selector history after CAS. The final receipt never hashes itself as a prerequisite.
admission.source_transition: Canonical source selection belongs to the single admission selector change. The later runtime source transition records observation and reader adoption for the admitted snapshot. It creates no additional admission effect.

verification_boundary.trusted_input: A selected verifier reads original bytes and validates authority, scope, cut, policy and correlation before constructing a typed proposition. Application JSON and nonempty proofs do not establish trust.
verification_boundary.identity: Use the exact admitted role-assignment and authority source for the workspace and operation. Resolve the verification policy by original bytes and reject unknown issuers, policies and stale authority.
verification_boundary.proof_binding: Bind the entire canonical request and verified proposition, including selector, before-state, operation, revision and subject members when present. Return an error on any mismatch. Compare typed fields in the planning kernel.
verification_boundary.snapshot: Prepare every authoritative consequence and reader qualification before selector CAS. Legacy readers prevent qualification. Recovery checks the original operation and its selector history.
verification_boundary.join_key: Resolve workspace/run_ref and workspace/original_operation to one surrogate using the journal adapter and enforce both uniqueness keys atomically. Same request and replay key return original receipt. Different request conflicts. Historical read uses resolved id/workspace with no current-cut filter.
verification_boundary.construction: Manifest verifier attests exact stage subjects, obligated checks, selection partition and applicable prototype/profile commitments. The independent verifier binds the entry receipt, actual output and complete per-spec result set.
